name: @singleton-sd/post-kit-publisher
description: Compile and publish PostKit email templates to Azure Blob Storage

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @singleton-sd/post-kit-types run build && pnpm --filter @singleton-sd/post-kit-compiler run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: echo "lint:publisher — covered by root eslint on staged files"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @singleton-sd/post-kit-types run build && pnpm --filter @singleton-sd/post-kit-compiler run build && tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json && node --import tsx --test "src/**/*.spec.ts"
